hypothesis: A small native change may add useful facts to a pre-existing cache even after it receives the actual update notice and fresh retrieval. Test the fitted rank-four matrix correction from shared_read_basis, with and without a text notice, before any future questions are available. Test other cache banks separately. Do not train or route on these outcomes.
data: Use all twelve previously exposed shared_read_basis evaluation documents, six bAbI and six MQuAKE; fitted bases came from separate document IDs. Each document receives one update and a single three-turn chat: changed fact, unaffected fact, then a new phrasing of the changed question after an intervening answer. Use official second MQuAKE paraphrase with identical target aliases; use a deterministic alternative wording for the public bAbI location question. The sender gets no question, including the paraphrase. Do not open unused subjects.
policies: Exact old-cache reuse, old-cache reuse plus a dated change notice, old-cache reuse plus that notice and current-fact lexical retrieval on every question, fresh retrieval with an empty factual prefix and the same search, exact full replay, exact checkpoint replay, bounded 16-token replay keeping later recurrent matrices stale, a native rank-four matrix-only patch, the same native patch plus the same notice and retrieval, and the full-bank shared projection from the preceding pilot. All policies have the same original and updated texts available at the update service. Only the use made of these inputs differs. The receiver gets wire bytes for any updated facts it needs to search or append. Retrieval is over the current version in original order. Log actual outputs across turns including previously generated replies.
cost: Run actual Qwen3.5-9B four-bit with one measured cap of 1 Gbit/s over local sockets. Charge original ingestion separately per policy, including the logical bytes for old checkpoints vs a final-only cache. Charge the one-time installed basis separately and the complete cold or warm update, notice application, per-question retrieval, and all generated replies. Treat labels, extraction of benchmark question strings and scoring as evaluation only. A three-turn pilot does not prove long-run retention.
quality_and_gate: Report free exact-reference matches for turns 1, 2, 3; jointly correct phrasings; regenerated sequence agreement with full replay; and pair-level gains and losses relative to old+notice+retrieval. For a genuine persistent-method promotion, the matched native+notice+retrieval must add >=2 jointly correct changed facts over every available cheap text/reuse baseline, including old+notice+retrieval and fresh retrieval, without losing an unaffected answer, and cut mean complete cold service >=20% vs full replay including the original ingestion. Report cache-ready and warm times separately. An accuracy tie or agreement with full rebuild is insufficient. An isolated complement may motivate future research but does not change this gate.
budget: Local M5 GPU up to 25 minutes; one implementation repair. Preserve all exposures, misses, and cheap baselines. No paid GPU for an unpromoted update.
